text: Modular pipeline single-cell single-nuclei RNA-seq analysis including quality control, preprocessing, dimensionality reduction, clustering, annotation, differential expression, trajectory analysis, cell-cell communication, visualization. Built SingleCellExperiment (Bioconductor). Named figures Greek mythology (Hephaestus's creations).

text: sce SingleCellExperiment raw counts assay. condition_col Character. colData column condition labels (must exactly 2 levels). sample_col Character. colData column sample/replicate IDs used pseudobulk aggregation (one pseudobulk column per sample). cluster_col Character. colData column cluster labels. Default "cluster". assay_name Character. Assay aggregate.  Must raw integer counts. Default "counts". reference_level Character NULL.  condition level reference (denominator) DESeq2 contrast.  NULL (default), alphabetically first level used. min_cells Integer. Minimum cells sample must contribute cluster included pseudobulk replicate.  Samples threshold dropped. Default 10L. min_samples Integer. Minimum number replicates required per condition per cluster min_cells filtering.  Clusters meeting requirement skipped. Default 2L. fdr_threshold Numeric NULL. title: Pseudobulk differential expression via DESeq2 — KERAUNOS_de_pseudobulk
text: statistically rigorous multi-sample approach: biological replicate contributes one pseudobulk column, eliminating pseudoreplication.  Requires least min_samples replicates per condition per cluster cell-count filtering.

what: Run GSEA between pairs of clusters using marker effect sizes — KERAUNOS_gsea_markers_pairwise
title: Run GSEA between pairs of clusters using marker effect sizes — KERAUNOS_gsea_markers_pairwise

Ranking statistics come scran::scoreMarkers() pairwise effect sizes (via KERAUNOS_rank_pairwise_markers), computed single-cell resolution — unlike DESeq2 pseudobulk DE, require \(\ge2\) biological replicate samples per cluster, making suitable comparing two specific clusters directly (e.g. two developmentally-related visually-adjacent clusters) even sample composition skewed cluster dominated one sample/clone.
